metadata.not_yet_sourced: EVERY END YEAR HERE IS A FLOOR, NOT AN ENDING. The report could not date the end of passenger service anywhere on this railroad: branchline.uk leaves the C&NW's late letters (a-d) blank in every state legend, so the source that would bracket the end does not do so. The 1951 ends come from the Feb 1952 Official Guide proving service still ran, not from any discontinuance date. Real service ran later than drawn — the hard ceiling is 30 April 1971, C&NW's last intercity passenger day. Powers - Iron River is drawn to 1929 for the same reason: that is a dated working timetable, not an ending.
metadata.omitted_branches: The report marks 35 of its 74 blocks `drawable: NONE` — real passenger lines with no confirmable year — and they are deliberately not drawn. A further set traced but failed this pass's quality gate (mileage within 15% of the documented figure, and at least 35% of the trace on C&NW-tagged track); those are listed in the campaign report rather than drawn with geometry that would be partly another railroad's.
